_comment: The one source for every Suede AI call to action in the Agent Skills Directory and the Awesome catalog. scripts/build-directory.mjs and scripts/build-awesome-directory.mjs read this file; edit copy, URLs, placement and routing here, then rebuild. offers is the plain two-card services module, shown on the page kinds switched on in placements. campaigns holds placement-specific variants: each URL already carries utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign (the campaign id) and utm_content (the variant id), so keep them intact. Where a campaign has several variants for the same route, the build picks one per page from a stable hash of the page path, so variants rotate across pages and clicks can be compared by utm_content. A variant with a confirm_offer note names an offer suedeai.agency has not confirmed: the build never renders it and uses the plain services offer instead. Copy follows the CLAUDE.md sales-copy standard: no em dashes, no invented proof, results, prices or guarantees. CTAs never appear inside third-party descriptions, install commands, publisher credit or correction flows.
